title: Graduation Day

beats.narrativeText: Director Orion welcomes the learner back to Explorer Academy Headquarters.
The Academy is about to celebrate something — but not what the learner might expect.
The learner reviews their Explorer Journal and reflects on their entire learning journey.
beats.trigger: Journal reviewed and journey reflected on

beats.narrativeText: The Academy celebrates not what the learner discovered, but how they investigated — observing carefully, asking thoughtful questions, testing ideas and revising conclusions when evidence changed.
The learner must identify their favourite investigations and complete a final expedition report.
beats.trigger: Favourite investigations identified and report completed

beats.narrativeText: The learner officially graduates from probationary status and receives their Explorer Certificate.
Atlas reveals that numerous other expeditions remain active across the world, each investigating different scientific mysteries.
A final transmission arrives from another research station, quietly hinting at what might come next.

activities.title: Reflect on Your Learning Journey
activities.storyContext: Director Orion welcomes the learner back to Explorer Academy Headquarters.
activities.instructions: Reflect on your entire journey through the campaign, from the first invitation to now.
activities.output: A written reflection on the whole learning journey.

activities.title: Review Your Explorer Journal
activities.storyContext: The Explorer Journal has recorded every observation since Mission 1.
activities.instructions: Look back through your Explorer Journal from the very first entry.
activities.output: Notes on what stands out from reviewing the journal.

activities.title: Identify Favourite Investigations
activities.storyContext: The Academy celebrates how the learner investigated, not just what they discovered.
activities.instructions: Identify your favourite investigations from the campaign and explain why.
activities.output: A list of favourite investigations with reasons.

activities.title: Complete Final Expedition Report
activities.storyContext: A final expedition report will close out the Outpost Echo investigation.
activities.instructions: Complete a final expedition report summarising the whole campaign.

activities.title: Receive Explorer Status
activities.storyContext: The learner officially graduates from probationary status.
activities.instructions: Personalise your Explorer Certificate to mark officially becoming an Explorer.

activities.title: Design Your Own Future Expedition
activities.storyContext: Atlas reveals that numerous other expeditions remain active across the world.
activities.instructions: Design your own future expedition — where would you go, and what would you investigate?
activities.output: A design for a future expedition.

activities.title: A Question With No Complete Answer
activities.storyContext: Real exploration never really ends — there are always new questions to investigate.
activities.instructions: Research a real-world scientific question that still has no complete answer.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: What kind of Explorer have you become?

discussionPoints: What kind of Explorer have you become?
What would you like to investigate next?
parentGuide.preparation: No special preparation required. Consider celebrating this milestone together.
parentGuide.assessment: Look for genuine reflection on growth across the whole campaign, not just a summary of what happened.

completionCriteria: Learning journey reflected on, favourite investigations identified, and final expedition report completed.
